title: Server-side request forgery through a caller-controlled request target
root_cause: A caller-supplied string is used directly as the target of GeneralUtility::getUrl(). Because neither scheme nor host is constrained, the request can be redirected at link-local metadata endpoints, localhost services, or hosts inside the private network, and the response is returned to the caller.

origin.reference: SsrfGeneralUtilityGetUrlRule; OWASP A10:2021 Server-Side Request Forgery
origin.note: The SSRF advisory in the local knowledge store (TYPO3-PSA-2024-005) carries no source link and is a synthetic seed. This pair documents the contract of SsrfGeneralUtilityGetUrlRule, including its allow-list exemption: a target that static analysis resolves to a fixed set of constant strings is not reported.
